title: Towards an Enhanced Understanding of Bias in Pre-trained Neural Language Models: A Survey with Special Emphasis on Affective Bias
findings: The survey reports that large pre-trained language models, particularly GPT-3, exhibit significant negative bias and harmful stereotypes against religious groups, especially Muslims. Models were found to associate Muslims with violence and terrorism through text completion and other analyses, likely due to Islamophobia present in the training data.
